note: Kill-shell disposition registry (plans/kill-shell.md, Phase 0): the closed world and export manifest in one. Every tracked metasystem shell file carries an entry; verdicts are port+shim / port+delete / keep; a live entry is done when verified carries a date and the shape held; deletions move to tombstones and pair with docs/migrations.md entries. Callers are recorded evidence, never a closure claim. go-packages is template-only, gated on the metasystem module.
